title: Work Map bridge-authorized exact-head writer v2 connectivity

phases.objective: Prove that one immutable pull-request bridge consumes the one-time authorization marker and dispatches a workflow-dispatch-only exact-head writer, while Integration and every other pipeline remain non-writers and all generated Work Map writes are serialized by the current branch-scoped concurrency key.

e2e_journeys.actor: governed Work Map recovery control plane
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository open pull request targeting main carries the one-time Work Map authorization marker on an immutable event snapshot.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge consumes the marker once, dispatches the sole writer with the exact branch and head SHA, the writer validates identity and serializes generation without force push, and exact-head CI and Integration verification are dispatched while all non-writers remain mutation-free.
steps: Validate the immutable pull-request base, head, repository identity, state, target branch, and authorization marker inside the E2E recovery bridge.
Consume the marker with readback and dispatch spec-kit-work-map-autofix.yml using branch and expected_head_sha inputs.
Require the writer to run only through workflow_dispatch, check out and pin the exact authorized SHA, and resolve exactly one same-repository pull request targeting main.
Validate generator, classification, connectivity, and governance contracts before generating any Work Map file.
Generate twice, prove idempotency, reject changes outside docs/work-maps, and serialize the branch writer with the exact current concurrency resource key.
Commit and push without force only when generated Work Maps changed, verify the remote result SHA, then dispatch exact-head CI and Work Map Integration.
Prove through repository regressions that marker consumption cannot move back into the writer and generation cannot move into the bridge or Integration.
assertions: The authorization marker and PATCH consumption remain in the E2E recovery bridge and are absent from the writer.
The recovery bridge contains no Work Map generator write, git add, git commit, git push, protected-branch mutation, or force push.
The writer exposes workflow_dispatch only and rejects pull_request, push, schedule, and workflow_run triggers.
The writer requires the exact local and remote expected_head_sha and exactly one open same-repository pull request targeting main.
The writer uses spec-kit-work-map-artifacts-${{ github.repository }}-${{ inputs.branch }} with cancel-in-progress false.
Integration generates only an exact-head local repair candidate and performs no remote commit or push.
Pipeline connectivity, supervisor assurance, and automation overlap regressions all agree on the bridge-authorized writer v2 architecture.

phases.objective: Merge the repaired connectivity contracts, reauthorize the original currentness probe, and collect one successful exact-head writer and Integration evidence cycle before merging the generated Work Map refresh.
